Launch the sciVizModules module gallery

Source: R/moduleGallery_app.R
sciModuleGalleryApp.Rd

Builds the sciVizModules Gallery: every module on its own tab, each opening on an example dataset with the module's main features already switched on (labelled genes and variants, risk tables, trajectories, terminal fits, annotation tracks, splits and so on), plus a Figure Builder tab for composing the data-frame modules into one multi-panel figure.

Usage

sciModuleGalleryApp(title = "sciVizModules Gallery", return_components = FALSE)

Arguments

title

A character string used as the navbar title and page title.

return_components

Logical. When FALSE (the default) a shiny::shinyApp() object is returned. When TRUE a named list with ui and server elements is returned instead, which is convenient for deployment scripts that need an explicit shinyApp(ui, server) call.

Value

Either a shiny::shinyApp() object, or (when return_components = TRUE) a list with elements ui and server.

Details

The tabs sit in navbar menus by field (Expression, Enrichment, Single-cell, PCA, Genomics, Mutations, Clinical, Pharmacology, Structure), and an Overview page lists every module as a card that opens its tab. Each tab carries the module's full set of controls, a link to its reference documentation, and beneath the plot either a filterable data table that feeds it (for the modules that take a data frame) or a read-only preview of the object it is bound to.

A module's server starts the first time its tab is opened, so the gallery launches quickly and a module that is never visited costs nothing. Example datasets are read once and shared between the tabs that use them.

The settings each tab opens on are the ones the module's own *App() function (e.g. volcanoPlotApp()) and the Figure Builder start from, so any of them can be reproduced by passing the same defaults to the module in your own app.

Modules whose optional packages are not installed are left out, and their cards on the Overview name the packages to install: the heatmap modules need ComplexHeatmap, InteractiveComplexHeatmap and circlize; the bulk expression modules the airway data package; the somatic-mutation modules maftools; goFanPlot GOfan and org.Hs.eg.db; and doseResponse drc.

The same app ships as system.file("apps/module-gallery", package = "sciVizModules") for deployment to a Shiny server, shinyapps.io or Posit Connect.

See also

sciFigureBuilderApp(), VizModules::moduleGalleryApp() for the VizModules modules.

Author

Jared Andrews

Examples

library(sciVizModules)
app <- sciModuleGalleryApp()
if (interactive()) shiny::runApp(app)

# The UI and server separately, e.g. for a deployment app.R:
parts <- sciModuleGalleryApp(return_components = TRUE)
if (interactive()) shiny::shinyApp(parts$ui, parts$server)
